svg.title: ODDT logo: aldose reductase–M15, PDB 4LB3
svg.desc: A compact schematic of M15 in a decorative teal protein pocket, based on PDB 4LB3. Eight ODDT-calculated contacts are shown: two gold hydrogen bonds to His110 and Trp111, one violet iodine halogen bond to Thr113, and five teal dotted hydrophobic contacts to Trp20, Trp111, Phe122, Leu300, and Tyr309.
